description: One strategy by id (think-tank/<slug>) or slug: the shelf entry, its playbook, its `actions`, its agent rules (strategy.json + STRATEGY.md) — returned only when they hash to the sha256 the shelf publishes, otherwise `rules.ok: false` with the reason — and its manager template (the pools a manager for it is created with). `next` says how to run it: prepare_create_manager with this strategy, then deposit and an operator, and watch_strategy for the Watcher.
name: get_strategy
title: One Think Tank strategy in full
